component.name: InkLeaf PDF
component.summary: Free, open-source PDF editor that edits the actual text

description.p: InkLeaf PDF edits, signs, fills, converts and organises PDFs. Everything happens on your computer: nothing is uploaded, there are no accounts, and every tool is free.
It changes the text that is actually in the file, in its original font, so the old words are really gone.

ul.li: Edit text, add pictures, shapes, highlights and sticky notes
Fill in forms, or make your own fillable forms
Sign with a drawn, typed or uploaded signature
Combine, split, reorder, rotate and crop pages
Make scanned pages searchable with OCR
Convert to and from Word, Excel, PowerPoint and pictures
Compare two versions of a PDF

description.p: The AI tools, network scanners, language packs and sending to a phone use the network, only when you use them.

screenshot.caption: Edit text, mark up and organise pages in one window

description.p: Fixes for the Flatpak: the app menu entry opens files correctly.
Inkleaf is now called InkLeaf PDF.

ul.li: New ribbon toolbar, which you can collapse or switch back to the classic toolbar
The Open button has a menu with recent files, combine, convert and scan
Bookmarks inside bookmarks, and right-to-left two-page reading
Faster opening, saving and OCR, and less memory on long PDFs
Start at login now works in the Flatpak
